change.name: tiny outgoing probe before suffix scan
change.summary: After suffix head miss and before the 32-edge incoming suffix scan, probe producer.firstOut and a single second outgoing edge for an existing edge to this consumer. A hit reuses and moves that edge through the existing moveIncomingEdgeToPosition path.

verdict.reason: The first outgoing edge is a near-perfect implicit lookup for the pathological far-found cases, avoiding the 32-edge incoming scan without adding an index or a new adaptive mode.
verdict.nextStep: Run runtime/facade tests and repeat benches, then consider keeping this before trying adaptive index again.
